turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
I'm not here to be complimented. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
Is there a reason you're not answering me? Who decided on the zero?
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
Not today. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
